title: Band-9 Samples: What types of music do you like to listen to? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 10 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 1 Test 2 question: “What types of music do you like to listen to? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male I can’t exactly pin down the genre of music I typically enjoy, but I hold a preference for popular English tunes. They’re certainly catchy, but more importantly, they serve as a dynamic tool for enriching my English vocabulary. The lyrics of these songs are a treasure trove of new words and phrases, making them not just recreational, but educational. Sample 2 Female Male I’m a big fan of pop music. The catchy tunes and upbeat rhythms are irresistible to me. I love how it reflects contemporary culture and trends, and it’s a great way to unwind after a long day. Pop music also has the ability to connect people from all walks of life, which I find very appealing. Sample 3 Female Male Country music is what I usually listen to. The storytelling aspect of country songs is what hooks me. Every song narrates a unique tale, often about life, love, or heartbreak. The humble tones and simple, yet expressive lyrics, have a way of stirring up emotions and leaving a lingering impact. Sample 4 Female Male I’m particularly fond of Electronic Dance Music, or EDM as it’s commonly known. The pulsing beats and synthesized sounds make for an exhilarating listening experience. EDM ignites a sense of excitement and energy in me like no other genre does. It’s the perfect soundtrack for a workout or when I’m in the mood for some lively entertainment. Sample 5 Female Male Indie rock has a special place in my heart. I find the genre refreshingly unique and original, often providing a break from mainstream music. Its emphasis on personal and introspective themes resonates with me, as it offers a more intimate and authentic listening experience. Sample 6 Female Male I find myself drawn to genres of music that foster concentration, such as classical or instrumental. The soothing melodies serve as a catalyst for my focus and provide a harmonious backdrop to my tasks. This type of music, free from lyrics, allows my thoughts to roam freely without any verbal distraction. Sample 7 Female Male Lo-fi music is my go-to genre when I need to unwind. Its unobtrusive melodies and low-fidelity soundscapes form a perfect backdrop for relaxation. Whether I’m reading a book or simply reflecting on the day’s events, lo-fi’s calming vibe helps me transition into a peaceful state of mind. Sample 8 Female Male I’m quite partial to various types of melodies, and I often find that the kind of music I gravitate toward is largely contingent on my emotional state at the moment. For instance, when feeling calm and relaxed, I might find myself drawn to the soothing harmonies of classical music. On the contrary, if I’m in a more energetic mood, I might opt for the invigorating beats of electronic dance music. Sample 9 Female Male I’ve always been a person who enjoys a broad spectrum of music. Be it pop, rock, classical, or even country, I find great pleasure in all of them. I feel that each genre has its own unique charm and story to tell. They offer different perspectives on the human experience, and that’s something I find intriguing. Sample 10 Female Male Honestly, I can’t say I have a distinct preference for any particular genre of music. I mostly employ melodies as a tool for concentration while I am engrossed in my work or studies. The subtle sounds of instrumentals in the background help me focus and enhance my productivity.
